answer: The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing.
